decisions.statement: Every run says the tables are empty rather than saying once that the tables are empty.
The words said go to the watcher log rather than to the console.
A caller may hand in the log the words go to.
The rates come from the currency price lookup the pricing package has.
The costs come from the crown consumable price lookup that package has.
A crown consumable with no price is left out rather than valued at nothing.

definition: the currency rates and crown replacement costs handed to the inventory addon
